May running recap: mileage rebounded 103.6 → 194.5mi, EG 4,252 → 7,057ft, time 21 → 35.5hrs.

It's my comeback month: I regained enough strength and started ramping up. The last 3 weeks' mileage: 48, 55, 60. VO2max recovered from 45.3 to 48.7 (all-time high was 54). This month also marked my 100th parkrun and 80th HM!

Now 150.3mi behind my 2,500mi yearly goal (883.8mi in). I'm waiting til the end of this month to decide if I want to revise down my yearly goal. But hopefully the worst is over.
